verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions tool or function calling, or reasoning/thinking output parsing. It only shows a REST API, a subset of the OpenAI API, Anthropic Messages API compatibility, and integrations with coding agents. Native tool calling cannot be inferred from that compatibility alone, so this applicable serving-API axis has no direct evidence.
